items: Keep separate spaces for work, personal reminders and active projects using supported iCUE text fields.
Blank Entry fields make note cards, headings label them, and pinned items rise to the top.
Checklist completions are remembered locally so finished work can still be reviewed.
Cycle through boards automatically or switch instantly with touch tabs.
